dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, let's talk about rights at work. Is there a minimum wage in Thailand?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈlɛts ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ˈraɪts ət ˈwɜːrk. ɪz ðɛr ə ˈmɪnɪməm ˈweɪdʒ ɪn ˈtaɪlænd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, but it's different in each province, which surprises a lot of foreigners.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, bʌt ɪts ˈdɪfərənt ɪn ˈiːtʃ ˈprɑːvɪns, wɪtʃ sərˈpraɪzɪz ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈfɔːrənərz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Really? How much is it in Bangkok?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈhaʊ ˈmʌtʃ ɪz ɪt ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: About four hundred baht a day, which isn't much in a big city.
dialogue.reading: əˈbaʊt ˈfɔːr ˈhʌndrəd ˈbɑːt ə ˈdeɪ, wɪtʃ ˈɪzənt ˈmʌtʃ ɪn ə ˈbɪɡ ˈsɪti.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And do men and women earn the same?
dialogue.reading: ənd duː ˈmɛn ənd ˈwɪmɪn ˈɜːrn ðə ˈseɪm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not always. In some jobs, women earn less than men, which is unfair.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈɔːlweɪz. ɪn sʌm ˈdʒɑːbz, ˈwɪmɪn ˈɜːrn ˈlɛs ðən ˈmɛn, wɪtʃ ɪz ʌnˈfɛr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Is the gender pay gap a big problem?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ðə ˈdʒɛndər ˈpeɪ ˌɡæp ə ˈbɪɡ ˈprɑːbləm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I think it's getting smaller, but it's still there. My cousin Kwan had a problem like that.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk ɪts ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈsmɔːlər, bʌt ɪts ˈstɪl ˈðɛr. maɪ ˈkʌzən ˈkwɑːn ˈhæd ə ˈprɑːbləm ˈlaɪk ˈðæt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She discovered that a man on her team earned more for the same work, which made her really angry.
dialogue.reading: ʃiː dɪˈskʌvərd ðæt ə ˈmæn ɑːn hɜːr ˈtiːm ˈɜːrnd ˈmɔːr fər ðə ˈseɪm ˈwɜːrk, wɪtʃ ˈmeɪd hɜːr ˈriːli ˈæŋɡri.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Did she do anything about it?
dialogue.reading: dɪd ʃiː ˈduː ˈɛniθɪŋ əˈbaʊt ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She talked to her manager. Now every worker on the team gets the same pay, which is how it should be.
dialogue.reading: ʃiː ˈtɔːkt tə hɜːr ˈmænɪdʒər. ˈnaʊ ˈɛvri ˈwɜːrkər ɑːn ðə ˈtiːm ˈɡɛts ðə ˈseɪm ˈpeɪ, wɪtʃ ɪz ˈhaʊ ɪt ʃʊd ˈbiː.
